headline: Oil Falls 1.03 Percent to $95.47 as the Energy Pipe Turns Lower
narrative: Oil fell 1.03 percent to $95.47, money leaving the energy pipe. Copper fell 1.7 percent to $6.43, and that industrial-metals pipe sold with crude. The S&P 500 rose 0.18 percent to 7,555.13, a small equity bid against the offer in energy and copper.
author: jordan
